projectTitle: Pen plotting: From a p5.js sketch to an AxiDraw drawing
project_haiku: A generative sketch of Bézier curves becomes a drawing when a pen plotter can follow it. This piece is that path: p5.js, Inkscape, G-code, and an AxiDraw v3.
project_footer_CTA: Need a generative file that a pen can actually draw? This is the pipeline from the sketch to the plotter.
pageSummary:
The job

A p5.js sketch can fill a screen with curves. A plotter needs vectors, an order of strokes, and a machine that will follow them. The project was to take one Bézier sketch all the way to paper.

What we built

The sketch builds two closed shapes from anchors on a grid. Control points are random, then snapped to the same grid. The design is exported as vectors, edited in Inkscape, converted to G-code, previewed, and drawn on an AxiDraw v3.

Outcomes

The drawing on paper is the same geometry as the sketch, minus everything a pen cannot do. That constraint is the work.
